latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of Video Maker Freelancer (v1.0.0).
- Edit and deliver client-ready videos from raw clips (supports MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM up to 500MB).
- Cloud-based processing with simple upload, edit instructions, and quick export to 1080p MP4.
- Automated credential handling; works with both registered and anonymous users.
- Supports credits checking, job status, and error handling for various upload and export scenarios.
- Designed for freelance video editors to streamline editing and delivery workflows.
